added.summary: useClock() reads the world's tick and its length in seconds as of the last tick boundary, for a component that paces itself (a reveal, a countdown) without the wall clock; a replay sees the same values on the same tick.

The TSX conversation takes rate again: the line shows that many characters per second by the world's tick, starting again with each new line, and reports onRevealed once it is whole; a screen reader always reads the whole line. Under reduced motion it still reveals at the rate (the TSX UI cannot read that setting yet).
